title: ServiceQuality
description: TOGAF-sourced rootless archetype — cross-domain governance concept capturing quality-of-service expectations and commitments. Complements ISO 25010 product quality characteristics with TOGAF's architectural governance perspective on service-level expectations. Rootless archetype — used to qualify governance Directives and Norms relating to service delivery quality. TOGAF mapping: Service Quality (Content Metamodel — cross-domain governance attribute). Source framework: TOGAF (Service Quality, Architecture Governance).

qualityDomain.description: Quality-of-service domain. TOGAF mapping: Service Quality attribute classification in the Content Metamodel.

targetLevel.description: Target quality-of-service tier defining the expected service level commitment. TOGAF mapping: Service Quality level classification.

scope.description: Architecture scope to which this service quality applies. TOGAF mapping: Service Quality governance scope.

description.description: Human-readable description of the service quality expectation.
